evidence.quote: DeepSeek is developing its own AI chips to reduce its reliance on products from Nvidia and Huawei, which have so far been used in the development of the company's AI models.
evidence.one_line: Per Reuters citing three sources, DeepSeek is developing its own AI chips to reduce reliance on Nvidia and Huawei.
evidence.speaker: Reuters (three unnamed sources)

evidence.quote: DeepSeek's chips are being designed specifically for inference, the stage where trained AI models generate responses for users.
evidence.one_line: DeepSeek's in-development chips are reportedly designed specifically for inference.
evidence.speaker: Reuters (three unnamed sources)

evidence.quote: According to Reuters sources, DeepSeek's chip development project remains at an early stage.
evidence.one_line: Reuters sources say DeepSeek's chip project is at an early stage.
evidence.speaker: Reuters (unnamed sources)

evidence.quote: The news briefly weighed on Nvidia shares, which fell around 1.6% in US pre-market trading.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia shares fell about 1.6% in US pre-market trading on the news.
evidence.speaker: idnfinancials.com

evidence.quote: "Nvidia's position in China is effectively at zero and will remain that way. DeepSeek has almost no chance of selling chips outside China unless it gains access to advanced manufacturing technology," said analyst Richard Windsor of Radio Free Mobile
evidence.one_line: Analyst Richard Windsor says Nvidia's China position is effectively zero and will remain so.
evidence.speaker: Richard Windsor (Radio Free Mobile)

evidence.quote: Huawei has expanded its domestic market share and now controls around half of China's AI chip market, which is valued at approximately US$50 billion.
evidence.one_line: Huawei reportedly controls about half of China's AI chip market, valued at roughly US$50 billion.
evidence.speaker: idnfinancials.com (citing Reuters)

evidence.quote: The base model supporting DeepSeek R1 was trained using Nvidia's H800 chips, a product specifically designed for the Chinese market before the US government banned its export in late 2023.
evidence.one_line: DeepSeek R1 base model was trained on Nvidia H800 chips, which the US banned for export in late 2023.
evidence.speaker: idnfinancials.com (citing Reuters)

evidence.quote: In April, DeepSeek launched its V4 model, which had been optimised for Huawei Ascend chips, while Huawei revealed that training for the V4-Flash model also used Ascend processors.
evidence.one_line: DeepSeek launched V4 in April optimised for Huawei Ascend; Huawei said V4-Flash training used Ascend processors.
evidence.speaker: DeepSeek; Huawei

evidence.quote: OpenAI introduced its first inference chip, called Jalapeno, last month in collaboration with Broadcom, while Anthropic is also reportedly considering developing its own AI chips.
evidence.one_line: OpenAI introduced its first inference chip, Jalapeno, with Broadcom last month; Anthropic reportedly considering its own chips.
evidence.speaker: idnfinancials.com (citing Reuters)

evidence.quote: Reuters previously reported that the company was preparing its first funding round worth US$7 billion, with a valuation of between US$52 billion and US$59 billion
evidence.one_line: DeepSeek was reportedly preparing a first funding round of US$7 billion at a US$52–59 billion valuation.
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: The launch also drove a surge in demand for Huawei's Ascend 950 chips among Chinese technology companies.
evidence.one_line: Launch of DeepSeek V4 reportedly drove a surge in demand for Huawei Ascend 950 chips.
evidence.speaker: idnfinancials.com
